subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should Feishu invalid-token recovery invalidate only the affected account/appId, or may it clear every Feishu SDK client and CardKit token in the process?
rationale: Both scopes can recover the reported failure, but the current global scope changes multi-account authentication and delivery behavior; repository history and automated proof cannot determine whether that broader blast radius is intentional.

options.title: Narrow This PR
options.body: Pass the affected account or appId through the recovery path, invalidate only its SDK and CardKit entries, retain the existing live proof, and make this the canonical candidate.

options.title: Accept Global Invalidation
options.body: Keep the process-wide clear only after adding multi-account live or integration proof showing unrelated accounts remain deliverable without problematic authentication bursts.

options.title: Select The Sibling Design
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97431 only after it is narrowed, rebased, and supplied with positive real-behavior proof comparable to this PR.

recommendation.title: Narrow This PR
recommendation.body: Pass the affected account or appId through the recovery path, invalidate only its SDK and CardKit entries, retain the existing live proof, and make this the canonical candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The package identifies m1heng as the Feishu community owner, making them the best available owner for the multi-account cache-scope decision.
